items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: unless I sneaked a solo in behind somebody that was playing a, singing a song like Helen Humes or Thelma Carpenter.

ctx.x: Yes. You had to do it. But it used to kind of burn me sometimes. I would go for
four or five weeks and not play a solo on the stage unless I sneaked a solo in behind somebody that was playing a, singing a song like Helen Humes or Thelma Carpenter.
